title: California governor vetoes bill banning use of 'pervert glasses' to secretly record people | TechCrunch
summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom has used his veto authority to send a bill passed by the state’s legislature back to lawmakers, which would have made it unlawful to secretly record people with wearable recording devices.
